description: This file defines the IGrainDirectoryResolver interface, which provides a method to resolve and retrieve an IGrainDirectory instance based on a GrainType and properties within the Orleans runtime grain directory namespace.

classes.name: IGrainDirectoryResolver
classes.description: An interface that associates a GrainType with an IGrainDirectory instance and provides a method to resolve the directory based on grain type and properties.

methods.name: TryResolveGrainDirectory
methods.description: Attempts to resolve and retrieve an IGrainDirectory for the specified GrainType and properties. Returns true if successful, false otherwise.
